source: sim/scenarios/caution-and-sectors.txt (v1 ASCII scenario, transcribed at M7)
description: Sector-yellow and caution scenarios: sector bands with and without a global flag, VSC, Safety Car, and red overriding VSC.

steps.note: Yellow ahead in sector 2 - sector band lights up; rest of the panel is the racing-idle splash since F=N.
Driver enters S2: now the global flag is yellow too, sector still lit.
Yellow extends to S3 as well (host emits both bits while driver in S2).
VSC plus a sector hint (host telling us the trigger zone).
Promoted to a real Safety Car - yellow base with a sweeping band.
Red flag drops while VSC was still active. Red overrides caution; the sector band is also suppressed under red. Onset white flash plays.
